prompt: For each day from 1 to 7 December 2025, by event_date, count the sessions and the engaged sessions. A session is one user_pseudo_id with one ga_session_id, counted from its session_start event; leave out session_start events whose user_pseudo_id or ga_session_id is missing. A session is engaged when its session_engaged parameter is '1', as text. Return event_date, as the text the export stores, sessions and engaged_sessions. Return one row for each day with a session start; a day with none has no row. Any row order is fine.

output_contract.grain: one row per event_date from 1 to 7 December 2025

hints: Next, read ga_session_id and session_engaged out of each session_start's parameters.
Count distinct pairs of visitor and session ID; an engaged session has session_engaged '1' as text, in the text slot.

  -- one row per session_start event from 1 to 7 December 2025

why_this_works: Two list_filter calls read two parameters of the same event, and the visitor with the session ID counts each session once.
faded_suffix:

  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251207'

  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN session_engaged = '1' THEN user_pseudo_id || '-' || CAST(ga_session_id AS VARCHAR) END) AS engaged_sessions
